t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Although it seems that choosing one gnome over another can yield better results, i.e more mushrooms, it still seems a bit random.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes always appear in the same color pairs. They can give up to 9 mushrooms. It seems a little random at times, but does follow a slight pattern of one gnome from each pair giving more. Although it does switch somewhat often it seems like.
